response: President Abinader is clearly more focused on courting global institutions than protecting our national sovereignty and traditional way of life. On 25 March 2026 in Paris, he stood by while Foreign Minister Roberto Álvarez signed a Memorandum of Understanding with OECD Secretary-General Mathias Cormann to create the Dominican Republic's first National Integrity and Anti-Corruption Strategy. This is just another step toward letting outside progressive bodies dictate our internal affairs instead of relying on strong domestic authority, personal responsibility, and the cultural continuity that has kept our society stable.
